candidates.name: SID-Set (SIDA)
candidates.repo_status: New lead: no prose-doc match found in visual-quality/docs or visual-triage/research (evidence directories excluded).
candidates.priority: First edit-detection pilot, conditional on source and parent audit
candidates.size: 300,000 in paper: 100,000 real OpenImages V7; 100,000 FLUX synthetic; 100,000 tampered (80,000 object-tampered + 20,000 partially tampered). Public HF train210,000+val30,000; test60,000 is separate official download.
candidates.labels: Three classes: real=0, full_synthetic=1, tampered=2; binary manipulation masks. Real img_id links OpenImages. Separate 3K descriptions are GPT-4o generated, not human gold.
candidates.access: Official public Hugging Face release and linked Drive train/validation/test; no media downloaded in this research.
candidates.terms: Official card CC BY4.0; source rights must be kept separately. Card's blanket description of COCO/OpenImages/Flickr30k as CC BY4.0 does not establish each photo's rights.
limitations: Full synthetic mostly FLUX, so retain other-generator external tests.
Real source differs from some generation/tampering parents; prevent shortcut learning on source provenance.
Group all derivatives by original photograph; no random per-image split.
Mask identifies altered support, not subjective quality.
candidates.quality: Author card, code repository and conference paper cross-checked.

candidates.name: OpenSDID / OpenSDI
candidates.repo_status: New lead: no prose-doc match found.
candidates.priority: First cross-generator edit/localization evaluation after release terms clarified
candidates.size: 300,000 per official repo and paper Table2: 100k real+100k SD1.5 fake train; test50k real+50k fake across SD1.5, SD2.1, SDXL, SD3, FLUX.1. Paper Table1 has inconsistent 300k/450k entry; use release manifest, not that table.
candidates.labels: Real/fake, global versus partial generation, manipulation localization masks; VLM editing instructions; no human IQA or aesthetic MOS.
candidates.access: Author repo links separate HF train and test packages. Parent/HF agent should pin actual Hub release.
candidates.terms: Repo states CC BY-SA4.0 and also 'academic use'; clarify scope before commercial adoption. Authors source Megalith10M public-domain/CC0/government/no-known-restrictions images; preserve per-image provenance.
limitations: Train generator is SD1.5; modern held-out generations are evaluation, not free extra training rows.
Need source-family isolation and matching of real/edited derivatives.
Do not mistake local editing support for detection of arbitrary editing tools.
candidates.quality: Author repo, project and CVPR paper agree on principal release design; license wording and one paper count conflict retained.

candidates.name: OpenFake v2
candidates.repo_status: Previously mentioned in pilot-preflight-2026-09-29.md; newly verified v2 repair/schema/counts, not wholly new dataset.
candidates.priority: Small pinned external evaluation, not bulk training
candidates.size: Current raw README metadata: core/train2,300,034; validation58,453; test91,397; reddit/test36,087. These are card counts, not our byte-level recount.
candidates.labels: real/fake; model; type; release_date; row_id; image_sha256; prompt_kind; prompt_model/revision/version.
candidates.access: Public HF; several TB for full core—select bounded strata.
candidates.terms: Current raw README both YAML and prose CC BY-NC4.0; source-specific proprietary/image terms remain. Exa blob cache had older conflicting prose, superseded by raw read.

No authoritative source-pair field established here; do not claim exact caption-matched real/fake pairs.
candidates.quality: Author card and maintainer issue response; raw current card preferred over stale indexed blob.

candidates.name: MMP-2k
candidates.repo_status: New lead: no prose-doc match found.
candidates.priority: Small human-rated macro/intentional depth-of-field robustness panel
candidates.size: 2,000 macro photographs from Flickr, Unsplash, Pixabay, selected from15,700; 17 retained ratings per image from21 participants.
candidates.labels: Human five-point ACR values0/25/50/75/100, MOS and raw17 ratings; two humans agree defect type, magnitude and location. Reports are deterministic text templates from MOS+defect annotations, not LLM teacher text.
candidates.access: Author GitHub v1.0.0 release and public HF MMP-2k/MMP-2k. Author card lists 512x384/384x512 and1024x768/768x1024 variants; study-view mapping needs care.
candidates.terms: Official repository CC BY-NC-SA4.0; source photo grants separate. Author paper says source images selected under terms permitting modification/commercial use but this does not override release NC restriction.
limitations: Macro-specific, not broad ordinary-photo coverage.
Deliberate shallow depth of field must not automatically count as defect.
Resolution variants are the same2,000 sources, not4,000 independent images.
KonCept512 used for sampling, but target ratings are human.
candidates.quality: Original dataset repo, author HF card, full paper.

candidates.name: FGAesthetics
candidates.repo_status: Already catalogued; old catalog says data not found. HF agent/root checking newly available archives and small labels; Exa alone cannot prove archive contents.
candidates.priority: High-value same-scene ranking evaluation after label/archive and terms validation
candidates.size: 32,217 images in10,028 series; 44,863 pairs per primary supplement.
candidates.labels: Human pairwise comparisons and calibrated within-series ranks. Metrics/MLLMs/Gemini help filter series; ranks themselves human. Ambiguous comparisons filtered out.
candidates.access: Author-linked yzc002/FGAesthetics HF advertises19.6GB but viewer only1 illustration row. Do not infer absence from viewer; inspect file tree/labels (parallel HF work).
candidates.terms: No dataset-specific terms established by Exa pages. Inherits eight source datasets, including Q-Eval100K, Pick-a-Pic, NIGHTS, Midjourney, SPS, LSVQ, CPC, GAIC.
limitations: Overlaps existing image pools; split by original/source series and cross-reference source IDs.
Filtered ambiguous pairs overstate discrimination on near ties; retain a separately human-rated tie panel.
Ranks are not absolute MOS.
candidates.quality: Author project states human comparison protocol; primary supplement enumerates original sources and pair counts.

candidates.name: REPID (formerly DEAR)
candidates.repo_status: DEAR already catalogued. Rename/expanded release should be deduplicated, not new independent dataset.
candidates.priority: Conditional small same-scene style preference evaluation
candidates.size: Card claims5,000 scenes×6 renderings=30,000 images; >2.5M votes from13,648 evaluators. Official card still has100-scene-sample pretty_name; validate exact downloadable scope with HF manifests.
candidates.labels: Human left/right/tie comparisons of rendering styles, at least25 votes per pair; scene groups and processing attributes. Named mos field is pairwise preference, not technical MOS.
candidates.access: Public author HF card with train/test/full annotation configurations; linked MIT-Adobe FiveK source photographs.
candidates.terms: Annotations CC BY4.0; photographs research-only under separate MIT/Adobe FiveK licenses.
limitations: Not independent of DEAR or FiveK-derived experiments.
Group six styles per scene; retain ties and raw votes if released.
Photo processing preference ≠ technical degradation quality.
candidates.quality: Author current card, original license file and peer-reviewed paper; metadata conflict called out.
